seo.welcome_title: SchoolDay - Electronic Attendance and Face ID Turnstile System for Schools

seo.og_description: Modern electronic attendance system with facial recognition turnstiles and Telegram notifications to keep parents informed.
seo.feature_attendance_desc: Fully automated electronic attendance tracking for educational institutions. Every movement of students and staff is recorded in real-time with automatically generated analytics.
seo.feature_turnstile_desc: Prevent unauthorized access to schools and kindergartens with advanced Hikvision Face ID recognition technology. 100% guarantee of student safety.
seo.feature_notif_desc: Instant automated alerts when your child enters or leaves school. Reliable Telegram bot notifications for parent peace of mind and constant monitoring.
